_about: What each leader page says. Key = squad slug (/trip-leaders/<key>). bio = their squad page bio (lightly tidied). title = their squad title. chat: nyc = the SYB New York City WhatsApp chat, dm = 'ask me on Instagram'. qa: [question, answer, source] where source 'real' came from the squad bio, a Travel Hack Tuesday post or SYB HQ, and 'placeholder' was written for the leader to replace with their own words. chips = specialties.

adam.name: Adam Frater
adam.title: Shred Captain
adam.bio: Adam is a big boss in body weight, handstands and making people smile. And umm, he’s got a six pack, dude.
qa: I came on an SYB trip, found my people and never really left. A few trips later I was the one leading the workouts.
Handstands on the beach in Bali, with the whole crew trying to hold one longer than me. Nobody did.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I can teach almost anyone a handstand in a week. Almost.

alex.name: Alex Marks
alex.title: Senior Leader
alex.bio: Coming from London, this 6’5 gentleman will, with proper manners and sophisticated language, get you to play all sorts of silly games, from fitness to drinking.
qa: I came on my first SYB trip from London and ended up leading the next one. Eleven trips later, I’m still here.
Watching a group of total strangers in Morocco turn into a crew by the second night in the desert.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’m 6’5, and I will still fold myself into the back row of the van.
You don’t need to pack as much as you think, especially when the SYB swag is so fire. Pack lighter. You’ll realize you don’t need half of it.

bradford.name: Bradford Rahmlow
bradford.title: Senior Leader
bradford.bio: His career as a dancer led him to the fitness profession. He spent many years dancing professionally with NYC’s Urban Ballet Theater and toured with the musicals. Also, he grew up in Hawaii, SYB central!
qa: Through fitness in New York. I started leading workouts with SYB, and the trips took over from there.
Ireland with Dan and Matas. Hiking all day, pub all night, and a group that sang the whole way home.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I danced professionally with NYC’s Urban Ballet Theater and toured with the musicals. And I grew up in Hawaii.
Americans on the red eye to Europe: grab a beer when you land. Your body is already in shock from the time change, and it helps set your intentions for the trip to come.

bri.name: Brianna Funk
bri.title: Sexy Suaveee
bri.bio: Bri brings the camera, the calm and the good energy. She’s the leader who gets the shot you’ll post for a year, and still makes sure you’re living the moment.
qa: I started on SYB trips behind the camera, then started leading them. Now I’m in Nicaragua more than I’m home.
Kenya. Watching the sun come up over the Mara with my crew.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I started on SYB trips as a photographer, so I already know your good side.

carri.name: Carri Bresnahan
carri.title: Energizer Bunny
carri.bio: Ever wondered what an espresso shot would be like in human form? Meet Carri. Powered by questionable amounts of caffeine and an unshakable belief that sleep is optional, she’s the first one up for sunrise workouts and somehow still leading the dance floor at 2am. When this Boston babe is around, you better be ready to rally.
qa: I came on the Croatia trip as a guest, and I went home wanting to be on the other side of it.
Leading the dance floor on the Croatia boat party, one year after I was a guest on that same trip.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
My battery has never actually run out. Science can’t explain it.
Bring a small packable tote or backpack for boat days, hikes and everything in between. The days are long, and it’s good to have sunscreen, water and the other essentials on hand.

cezary.name: Cezary Wojcik
cezary.title: Do It All Man
cezary.bio: He’s DJ’d on safari in SYB Kenya, he’s dressed up as a pirate and walked the plank on a pirate ship in SYB Croatia, he’s a semi-professional photographer, and he will do ALL the workouts with you even though he doesn’t sleep.
qa: One SYB trip turned into DJing on safari, walking the plank in Croatia and shooting photos everywhere in between.
DJing on safari in Kenya. There is no better dance floor.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’m a semi-professional photographer. I also don’t sleep.

christian.name: Christian Labertew
christian.title: Camp Counselor
christian.bio: Christian’s favorite way to start the day is a hearty “goooooood morning campers!” We don’t give him caffeine in the mornings. He’s already full of energy without the boost. You best believe he will be DJing and dancing on every bus ride, and there WILL be some country songs in the mix (we are sorry in advance).
qa: I came to an SYB event in LA, then a trip, and now I’m the one waking up the campers.
Iceland 2026. Hot springs, waterfalls, and a bus that turned into a dance floor every single day.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
There will be country songs on the bus playlist. I’m sorry in advance.

Spend half an hour at the airport or on the flight learning a bit about the culture and language where you’re going. The friendships you make with locals can be just as meaningful as the ones with your crew, and they’ll appreciate you trying.

courtney.name: Courtney Cochran
courtney.title: Breath Babe
courtney.bio: She’s been traveling with us since 2019, and after graduating from the SYB Academy (class of ’24), she’s basically been living in Nicaragua with the crew. You’ll catch her guiding breathwork sessions that unlock emotions you didn’t know you had, and catching waves like it’s her full-time job.
qa: I’ve been traveling with SYB since 2019. I graduated from the Academy in 2024 and basically moved into Nicaragua with the crew.
A sunrise breathwork session in Nicaragua that ended with half the group in happy tears.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
Breathwork can unlock emotions you didn’t even know you had. Ask anyone who has done a session with me.
Pack way less than you think you’ll need. If you’re going somewhere like Nicaragua, you’re pretty much only wearing swimsuits anyway.

dan.name: Dan Brown
dan.title: O’ DannyBoy
dan.bio: Originally a TV producer, he gave SYB a little try and then jumped in head first. From helping host our annual SYB Gala in NYC to leading the more adventurous trips like Ireland, Dan brings the organization and the night time vibes on ALL days.
qa: I was a TV producer who gave SYB a little try. Then I jumped in head first.
Helping host the SYB Gala in New York. A room full of alumni in black tie, and every one of them was a stranger once.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I used to produce TV, so yes, I will make the group photo happen.

darryl.name: Darryl Corley
darryl.title: Mr Hyrox
darryl.bio: This British lad has all the drinking games, all the deadly workouts, and all the comments to have you thinking twice about what he said. Was it the accent, or did he really say it? If you need a good laugh while sweating, this is your guy.
qa: I came on an SYB trip from London and I haven’t stopped since.
The pirate ship day in Croatia. Enough said.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’m a nutrition guy. Yes, really, the one with all the drinking games.

erin.name: Erin MacLeod
erin.title: High Vibes
erin.bio: Her vibe is all about keeping it fun and sexy, making sure everyone feels included, and doing it all with a big heart and an infectious attitude.
qa: I came on a couple of SYB trips as a guest and got hooked. Then I did the SYB Academy in Nicaragua, and I’ve been leading ever since.
Our Shellona day in Saint-Tropez. It was a free night on the Côte d’Azur trip, and all 27 of us went anyway. One long table, everyone toasting, nobody wanted to leave.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
Carry-on is king. No baggage claim, no lost luggage, no waiting around. Just grab, go, and start the adventure faster.

holly.name: Holly Lipman
holly.title: Sweat and Party Queen
holly.bio: High energy, a little chaotic and always down for the bit, Holly is your go-to for workouts that hit, whether it’s on a beach, a jungle gym or a boat. A Jersey girl through and through, she found SYB on our Egypt trip and never left the party. Fair warning: if Holly’s on your trip, someone’s losing their voice, and it’s probably her.
qa: I found SYB on the Egypt trip and never left the party.
Leading a workout on a boat in the South of France with 24 people screaming the countdown.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
My Spanish is just broken enough to get by with the locals.

jenny.name: Jenny Eisenberg
jenny.title: Pilates and Chill
jenny.bio: After a decade-plus of teaching Pilates in LA, she added yoga to her repertoire, graduating from the SYB Academy in 2024. She’s here to make you feel supported, encouraged and definitely challenged. Don’t be fooled: she’s tiny, but her workouts are tough.
qa: After more than ten years of teaching Pilates in LA, I added yoga and graduated from the SYB Academy in 2024.
Pilates on the deck in Nicaragua with the ocean right there. Hard to beat.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’m tiny, but my workouts are not.

jill.name: Jill Mercer
jill.title: Senior Leader
jill.bio: After learning the ropes from the SYB Academy and getting her yoga teacher training with us back in 2019, Jill has been nonstop leading trips all over the world with us!
qa: I learned the ropes at the SYB Academy and did my yoga teacher training with SYB back in 2019. I’ve been leading nonstop ever since.
Turkey 2025. Sailing, swimming, dancing, and a crew that felt like family by day three.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’ve been leading SYB trips since 2019, so ask me for the old stories.

juliana.name: Juliana Tordella
juliana.title: Senior Leader
juliana.bio: It all started on SYB Ibiza 2018. Then she crushed the SYB Academy yoga teacher training, and now she’s back to share the life-changing moments with you. BTW, she also teaches a beer shotgunning workshop.
qa: It all started on SYB Ibiza in 2018. Then I did the SYB Academy yoga teacher training, and now I help lead the Academy.
Ibiza 2018, my first SYB trip. The one that started all of this.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I teach a beer shotgunning workshop. It’s very official.

Hit up the WhatsApp group before the trip and figure out who you can meet at the airport you’re leaving from or laying over in. We often end up on the same flight, and you get to arrive with new friends.

lauren.name: Lauren Smith
lauren.title: Wild Heart
lauren.bio: Straight out of Seattle and a graduate of the SYB Academy, class of 2024, she brings big energy, warmth and that extra push you didn’t know you needed. A true mountain soul, a dedicated yogi and always the first to rally the crew, she’s here to make your week unforgettable.
qa: I came on an SYB trip, then graduated from the SYB Academy in 2024. The mountains did the rest.
Hiking the Dolomites with a crew that kept asking for one more hut.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I grew up in Seattle, so give me a mountain over a beach. Then give me both.

Use the Flighty app. It keeps your gate information in one place even when your trip spans different airlines, makes it easy to share your flights with friends or family, and shows you a fun recap of everywhere you went at the end of the year.

lizzie.name: Lizzie Allcock
lizzie.title: Grounded Fire
lizzie.bio: Portland raised and SYB Academy trained (class of ’24), Lizzie brings a calm that puts a room at ease, right before she cranks up the energy and asks you to go further than you thought you could. Part spiritual leader, part hype woman, she’ll have you moving harder, laughing louder and leaving the trip a little more open than when you arrived.
qa: Portland raised and SYB Academy trained, class of ’24.
The Philippines. Island hopping all day, and the whole crew dancing barefoot on the beach at night.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I make one playlist for the sunrise flow and a very different one for midnight.

meag.name: Meag Donnelly
meag.title: Heart of Gold
meag.bio: Meag’s heart says it all: go big or go home. After winning our Instagram giveaway in 2021, we just couldn’t get rid of her. Hailing from Boston, when she’s not traveling the world with SYB, she’s planning the Boston Marathon or working at her local fitness studio. Community is everything for Meag, and if you’re on a trip with her, she’ll make it everything for you too.
qa: I won an SYB Instagram giveaway in 2021, and they just couldn’t get rid of me.
Iceland 2026. Hot springs, waterfalls and the best group of humans.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
When I’m not traveling with SYB, I’m planning the Boston Marathon.
Search for flights in incognito mode, it can give you cheaper prices. If you have a VPN, set yourself in a different country. That can get you cheaper prices too.

nikki.name: Nikki Rosado
nikki.title: Young Spirit
nikki.bio: From guest to SYB Academy to SYB leader, Nikki has taken the full route. She knows everything from how to lead a perfect yoga class to waking you up early SYB style, and keeping the dance party lit all night.
qa: I came as a guest, did the SYB Academy and became a leader. The full route.
Turkey this summer. Boats, beach clubs and a group that never wanted to go to bed.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I’ll wake you up early SYB style, and I’ll still be on the dance floor at 2am.

sarah.name: Sarah White
sarah.title: Senior Leader
sarah.bio: She’s been on SYB Ibiza, she’s led the SYB Academy teacher training, and she’s proven that there is a beautiful balance between spirituality and a good party. She’s the ultimate good vibe to have leading your trip!
qa: I came on SYB Ibiza, and a few years later I was leading the SYB Academy teacher training.
Japan. Fresh powder in the morning, karaoke in Golden Gai at night.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
Spirituality and a good party go together better than you think.

sarahcat.name: Sarah Catenac
sarahcat.title: Shot Fairy
sarahcat.bio: Day one of her first SYB trip and she was already a lifer. After a few more adventures and local events, she graduated from the SYB Academy (class of ’24) and officially joined the crew. Since then, she’s been our shot fairy, coming in hot to kickstart the party. When she’s around, you’ll be on your feet dancing in no time.
qa: Day one of my first SYB trip, I was a lifer. A few more trips and local events later, I graduated from the SYB Academy, class of ’24.
Nicaragua with Matas last November. Strangers on day one, family by day four.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
You will be on your feet dancing within ten minutes of meeting me. Resistance is pointless.
When you’re traveling somewhere hot, pack a change of clothes in your carry-on for the ride after the flight.

sav.name: Sav Cyr
sav.title: Vegas Energy
sav.bio: Living in Las Vegas, she’s seen it all and nothing fazes her. She can bring the heat and bring the sweet. Sav is a recent grad of our SYB Academy, class of 2024, and her vibe is all about making memories that will last you a lifetime!
qa: I graduated from the SYB Academy in 2024, and I’ve been bringing the Vegas energy to trips ever since.
Belize. Golf carts, reef days and a crew that felt like old friends by the end of the week.
Something people wouldn’t guess about you?
I live in Las Vegas, so nothing on a trip fazes me.
